'''Varl''' was the original [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], [[t'landa Til]], and possibly the [[Rybet/Legends|Rybets]]. According to Hutt legend, it was devastated in a cataclysm that vaporized its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and obliterated its [[Moon/Legends|moons]], as well as all other planets in [[Varl system/Legends|its star system]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was located in the [[Varl system/Legends|Ardos system]], in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Oversector/Legends|oversector]]. It was the original capital of the [[Hutt Empire]], from the empire's formation in [[25,200 BBY]], to the planet's destruction in [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], where the Hutts relocated to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], as the sector and empire's new capital.

==Description==
On Varl, the size and shape of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] did not limit them, as opposed to when they moved offworld and began operating in the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], which was dominated by [[Limb/Legends|bipedal]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TCWnovel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>

==History==
===Early history===
Varl was a conquest of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], and was a part of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] for some period prior to the rise of the Hutts.

===The cataclysm===
[[File:Varl_goes_boom.png|thumb|left|170px|Varl was devastated during a cataclysm.]]

According to Hutt legend, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Varl orbited two suns, [[Evona/Legends|Evona]] and [[Ardos/Legends|Ardos]]. Evona and Ardos were venerated as gods by the Hutts. Evona was consumed by a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]], and in fury, Ardos expelled its gaseous external layers and destroyed the other planets of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].

Somehow, Varl survived, though its atmosphere was vaporized, its biosphere was annihilated, and it was left as a wasteland. The Hutt Empire fled Varl before the cataclysm, and soon resettled at their colony on Evocar, which they promptly renamed [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. They believed that by surviving the cataclysm, they had been elevated to the status of near-gods. The planet they left behind was reinhabited by the descendants of abandoned servants of the Hutts, with only a few squalid manufacturing centers built in airdomes.

====Speculation====
The tale was generally dismissed as Huttese hyperbole, and the most commonly accepted alternate theory was that the Hutts destroyed their world themselves in some ancient civil war, known as the [[Hutt Cataclysms]].<ref name="TEA" />

There were signs indicating that the cratered wasteland of the planet Varl was once a pleasant green world, and besides many [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], no other world orbited the [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] [[Ardos/Legends|Ardos]]. Presumably, the asteroids were the remains of Varl's moons, as researchers at the [[Baobab Archives]] claimed to have found Hutt artifacts "on the moons of Varl."

===Later history===
Varl remained sacred in Hutt tradition, and they forbade other ships approaching, holding patrol ships around the planet.<ref name="TEA" />

The Hutts declined to discuss its fate after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]].<ref name="TEA" />
